summary: Completed E2E testing of the three iteration-4 features on ClientVerse.io (Undo Actions, Webhook Signature Docs, Outcome Targets) plus regression. Backend: 15/15 existing tests + 6/6 new iteration-4 tests all pass. Frontend Playwright E2E confirms: (1) Webhook Verify dialog opens per endpoint, shows the signing secret (e.g. whsec_sink_...) via [data-testid=webhook-secret-value], copy-secret-button + copy-snippet-button present, HMAC-related snippet body detected. (2) Outcome Graph: goals render with progress bars (goal-progress-*) and 'current / target unit' + %, seeded 'Launch analytics platform' shows 65/100. Add-outcome now opens a shadcn Dialog (title + target-value inputs) — created TEST_dlg_goal via save-outcome-button and it rendered immediately. Inline goal-update-input-* + goal-save-* updated a goal's current value (55/100 → 77 verified visually). (3) MCP Undo: invoked create_task (L2) → approval_id apr_e27ec78110ae returned in mcp-result → approved via API → mcp-undo-* button appeared, clicked → row flipped to 'undone'; second undo blocked by backend (400). (4) Audit Undo: fresh L2 invoke+approve generated an 'agent.run_completed' event with audit-undo-* button; clicking it removed the task and produced a new 'mcp.tool_undone' event visible in the feed (Removed task task_70e3aa759b3f toast). Cross-tenant undo protected (404).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1231 lines (grew from 1185). Still exceeds the 700-line guideline; splitting into modules (auth, mcp, webhooks, outcomes, approvals) remains desirable but not blocking.

POST /api/mcp/invocations/{id}/undo currently only handles created==task|note. If future L2 tools create other entity kinds, the endpoint returns 400 'not reversible' — consider a dispatch map or per-tool undo strategy.
OutcomeGraph inline update: goal-update-input-* is uncontrolled between renders; consider syncing to props.current_value after PATCH so the input reflects the persisted value (minor UX).
Webhook Verify dialog snippet is copied via navigator.clipboard.writeText — no fallback for insecure contexts, but preview URL is HTTPS so OK.
